title: A Leased arg is refused at the bridge egress before any byte is produced
notes: source: WV-PORT-API-STALL-SUSPENDED-01, mutation: its single arg Stall(SUSPENDED) replaced by the lease wrapper around the kotlin.String "x" — SCHEMA.md §Encode-direction negatives' worked example, verbatim. Normative (spec 23 ownership: "Leased MUST NOT cross machine boundaries"): the sender's egress must refuse the send before encoding, so NO bytes exist to pin and this vector carries no `encoded`. The JVM driver builds the invocation from `decoded` with the wrapper stripped, re-wraps that arg in Leased, offers it to BridgeEgressCell.deliver and asserts the refusal classifies `leased-at-encode` and the egress outlet saw zero byte arrays ([WIR1-I16], epic B3.9).
